technique_name: Write a historical account of the Discovery of Penicillin
description: The discovery of penicillin is credited to Alexander Fleming, a Scottish scientist who was working at St. Mary’s Hospital in London in 1928. Fleming had grown cultures of Staphylococci bacteria in a Petri dish, placing it in an open window to let air pass over the culture. Unbeknownst to him, the bacteria were destroyed by spores from a nearby mold.
